title: Model Contract (== MODELSPEC.json)
description: Structural schema for the Stage 3 -> Stage 4 handoff artifact. Citation discipline (every non-unknown field must resolve to PAPER_ID:Lstart-Lend or repo:path:line) is enforced in harness/contract.py, not here, because it's a cross-field invariant JSON Schema expresses awkwardly.

cited_field.description: Every scientific/software claim is wrapped like this. value == "unknown" is always legal; if value != "unknown", citation must be present and match the citation pattern.

commit.description: A pinned SHA. Never the literal 'main'.

image.description: Built image tag/ref handed off from Stage 1 (RepoLaunch).

perturbation_encoding.description: gene_id => scope gate refuses upstream (E2). See harness/contract.py:scope_gate().

order_sensitive.description: Default MUST be 'unknown', not false. Two source docs disagreed on this default (todo.html gap #3); treating order as significant until cited otherwise is the resolution used here.

hyperparameters.description: Flagged gap (todo.html #8): this was '{...}' with nothing to assert against. Keys are free-form but each MUST be a cited_field, asserted at runtime by the adapter, with mismatches routed to DEVIATIONS.md rather than silently applied.

arguments.description: CLI arguments the rendered config.vsh.yaml exposes (its `arguments:` block). Optional -- absent/empty means the component takes no configurable arguments beyond the task's own de_train/id_map/output. Each entry's value is the argument's default; citation follows the same cited_field discipline (typically the repo's own train()/predict() signature).

dependencies.description: Pip/git packages the rendered engines.docker.setup installs, beyond the base image. Optional -- an empty/absent list defers entirely to the base image. Each entry's value is the version pin (or a git+URL); citation points at the repo file that declared it (setup.py/pyproject.toml/requirements.txt) or RepoLaunch's own reconstructed layer log.
